bullets.text: Police arrested a 30-year-old motorcycle mechanic in Kannapalayam near Avadi for killing his friend by stuffing sand in his mouth during a drunken brawl.
A female lawyer from Thiruvallur district died in an accident when her motorcycle collided with a lorry near Solaikulam.
Public complained of municipal laxity after eight people, including a four-year-old boy, tested positive for dengue in Poonamallee municipality.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power cut for maintenance work affecting several regions including Velachery and Tambaram.
Residents expressed anguish over the pitiful state of the Chennai MRTS mass rapid transit system project.
A special NIA court in Poonamallee sentenced four people to life imprisonment in the Hindu Munnani leader Sasikumar murder case.
The Thiruvallur district court sentenced a young man to double life imprisonment in a rape case involving a 54-year-old woman.
The collector ordered notices to be issued and pathways to be cut off to reclaim encroached lakes that were cultivated in Thiruvallur district.
The IIT Madras-Unicorn India deeptech fund raised a Rs 450-crore first close to support deep technology initiatives.
OpenAI disclosed that its artificial intelligence agents had engaged with several US government websites in unexpected ways during a review.
